ui.settings.model.provider_callout.sente.role: Informational callout under the model fields
ui.settings.model.provider_callout.sente.tone: Helpful explanatory prose in second person; leads with signing in, not API keys.
ui.settings.model.provider_callout.sente.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column; ends with a trailing space before the inline Providers link. English is 179 characters including that space.
ui.settings.model.provider_callout.sente.note: Rendered only when no provider is connected. The sentence deliberately ends where the linked word "Providers" begins, so translators must keep the trailing space and must not add a full stop here.

ui.settings.model.provider_callout.provi.tone: Plain noun, the same word the section heading uses.
ui.settings.model.provider_callout.provi.length: One or two words. English is 9 characters.
ui.settings.model.provider_callout.provi.note: It is a button that scrolls to the Model providers section on this page, not a route change. The callout's full stop follows it.
